answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when two of its attestations contradict each other, so running a hundred hollow shells costs a hundred stakes instead of one. Peers gossip a whisper of each identity's work history through the nebula of the network, and identities with no verifiable history earn no trust or rewards until established agents vouch for them with their own stake at risk.
